The National Museum, Janpath, New Delhi is open Tue to Sun, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and closed on Mondays and national holidays. Entry is ₹20 for adults and ₹500 for foreign nationals. Students up to class 12 enter free with an I-card. The Arms and Armour, Textiles and Jewellery galleries were closed for renovation per a notice dated 29 May 2023, and the site shows no update since.
